scope: All catalog entries visible in the homepage season list for each term. A food with peakTerms is included only for those solar-term indexes; otherwise its peakWindows or peakMonths must overlap at least one day in the term. The seasonStartTerm gate applies in either case. Repeat rate is the count also present in the immediately preceding term divided by the current term total. The first term compares with the immediately preceding White Dew.
gapNote: This is a total of per-term list entries that must not appear in the immediately preceding term; it is not a count of globally distinct food IDs. One food may contribute to multiple term lists only when its full sourced window supports those appearances.
